scope.flow: Withdrawing funds from a validator and confirming withdrawals via StakingManager
scope.environment: StakingManager contract on Hyperliquid (HYPE native token)
evidence: Unable to send the StakingManager contract the native token HYPE without triggering the stake() function. This makes it impossible `confirmWithdrawals` since the contract will automatically stake funds when they are withdrawn from the validator.
An easy fix is to add a payable function like `depositWithdrawalFunds` that will accept funds withdrawn from a validator. No other logic changes need to be made.
